page.overview:
What is A Song of Ice and Fire?

A Song of Ice and Fire is an award-winning series of bestselling books of epic fantasy novels by American author and scriptwriter George R.R — part of Game of Thrones.

The series currently comprises five published novels with two more anticipated to bring the series to a conclusion. The fifth book, A Dance with Dragons, was published on July 12, 2011. There are also three prequel novellas set in the same world.
